slides.headline: 5 things you probably missed on Nov. 25
slides.subline: **Weather, rescues and a farewell.** Swipe for the quick version.
slides.credit: Rhododendrites / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Macy’s balloon inflation, file photo)

slides.body: **Macy’s** postponed its Thanksgiving Day Parade to **Saturday** because of a nor’easter. Reuters and CBS say it is the [[first weather postponement]] in its history.
At least [[31 people]] died when a **fuel tanker crashed** and set off a huge fire on Cairo’s Ring Road, Egypt’s health ministry said. 21 were injured.
Security forces **stormed a supermarket in Cartagena** and freed the hostages after a siege of about 17 hours, Colombia’s president said. [[All hostages]] were rescued.
**King tides** and big waves flooded roads and businesses along California’s coast, the Guardian and Al Jazeera report. The tides were [[record-breaking]] in places.
**Andy Taylor**, the Duran Duran guitarist, has died at [[65]], the NYT, Guardian and DW report.
Which of these stories surprised you most? Tell us below.
